cycles.symptom: The first real local MP4 decoded successfully but the black-frame probe classified the intended dark visual system as black output.
cycles.root_cause: The FFmpeg blackdetect picture threshold was too permissive for the fixture's dark background.
cycles.repair: Tightened the actual-byte blackdetect thresholds to pix_th=0.10 and pic_th=0.98 while retaining a real frame probe.
cycles.verification: TechnicalMediaQC black_output=true and the complete actual-byte QC result is PASS.

cycles.symptom: M5 and M10.1 qualification fixtures retained historical runtime-mode and upload-readiness expectations.
cycles.root_cause: Pre-M12 fixtures encoded MOCK behavior implicitly and treated a missing final media file as upload-ready.
cycles.repair: Made MOCK explicit in offline fixtures, kept REAL as the schema default, and changed missing upload media to UPLOAD_INPUT_MISSING.
cycles.verification: M5 mode/default tests and M10.1 missing-file tests pass.

cycles.symptom: The repaired upload state was rejected by the database and qualification scanners flagged later approved R3D/Pexels boundaries.
cycles.root_cause: The upload-card check constraint and historical scanner allowlists lagged the active repository architecture.
cycles.repair: Added the forward 0038 constraint replacement and narrowly allowlisted the exact approved memory/vector and Pexels HTTP boundary paths.
cycles.verification: Fresh upgrade, downgrade/upgrade round-trip, upload-state test, and qualification scanner suite pass.

cycles.symptom: Strict envelope serialization and the D2P human-review status projection disagreed with their durable representations.
cycles.root_cause: A computed envelope hash was included in the wrong Pydantic validation surface and D2P projected the pre-review package state after an exact PASS receipt.
cycles.repair: Separated canonical hash validation from serialized content and projected PACKAGE_HUMAN_REVIEW_PASSED then READY_FOR_LONG_PRODUCTION from the durable ReviewTask/ApprovalDecision pair.
cycles.verification: Strict envelope negative matrix and D2P review-promotion tests pass.

cycles.symptom: The LPRO orchestration receipt artifact type was rejected by the repository artifact registry.
cycles.root_cause: The new durable orchestration receipt was not registered in the governed artifact-type catalog.
cycles.repair: Registered long_production_orchestration and advanced the catalog version to 1.3.0.
cycles.verification: D2P-to-LPRO application trigger and offline fixture persistence tests pass.

cycles.symptom: Five acceptance cases using a legacy SimpleNamespace Daily fixture failed before evaluating NICH behavior.
cycles.root_cause: The repaired M5 service assumed every historical test fixture exposed run_mode.
cycles.repair: Kept database/runtime semantics unchanged and added a compatibility read default only for legacy in-memory fixtures.
cycles.verification: The five focused cases and the original LPRO1 acceptance suite pass.

cycles.symptom: The amendment suite had one remaining failure because a pre-M7 qualification helper asserted 0031_r3d8_cost_firewall as the repository head.
cycles.root_cause: A shared stale-head constant was not found by the earlier 0021-specific scan.
cycles.repair: Updated the qualification head authority to the single active revision 0038_lpro1_daily_mode without weakening the assertion.
cycles.verification: The failed migration test passes and the full amendment suite is rerun as a terminal check.
